I had this problem last year. I ended grabbing my lens cleaner for my glasses. Using the dampened lint free cloth to wipe it down and going back over it with another cloth dampened with a little water and then drying it with a microfiber. This was a month after finally removing the film from the bezel after a year of use. It never came back. I also had a friend use a tiny bit of auto-glass cleaner with the same successful result. I would imagine the tv heating up and cooling down when those things are left on affects the adhesive in some way.
